description: Run one SML Triple-Trigger SPEC v2 scan of a ticker on live Schwab data and get a VERDICT (all three triggers true, with entry/stop/target/R plan), WATCH (two of three), or NONE result, with market/volatility/cap tags and data timestamps. Use it to check whether a ticker currently shows a liquidity sweep + Fibonacci reclaim (T1), a VWAP reclaim with relative-volume thrust (T2), and same-side unusual options premium vs the ticker's own 20-session baseline (T3). Missing data is reported as no_data, never estimated. $0.05 USDC on Base per accepted scan. First 3 VERDICT scans free with a trial key (pass trial_key; get one via POST /triple-trigger/trial); WATCH/NONE never consume credits.

trial_key.description: Optional free-trial key (tt_trial_...). When valid with credits left the scan runs unpaid; one credit is consumed only when the result is a VERDICT.

name: triple_trigger_scan

outputSchema.description: SPEC v2 result JSON: {ticker, mode, side, verdict, triggers:{t1,t2,t3}, plan, tags:{market,volatility,cap}, data_ts, scan_ts, source:"schwab"} plus filter/zone detail and trace_ids.

title: Triple-Trigger Scan
